q1: SELECT CLASS FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS HAVING COUNT(*)>=5
q2: SELECT CLASS FROM ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) AS COUNT FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS ) AS FOO WHERE COUNT >= 5

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT CLASS FROM ( SELECT CLASS, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) AS COUNT FROM COURSES GROUP BY CLASS ) AS FOO WHERE COUNT >= 5
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 counts all rows per class (including duplicates if a student appears multiple times for the same class). Q2 counts distinct students per class, which may yield different results if the same student appears multiple times in the same class.
counterexample_dsp: A class with 5 rows for the same student will not appear in Q2 (COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT) = 1 < 5) but will appear in Q1 (COUNT(*) = 5 >= 5).
